artifact.name: S9-A final model identity and remaining experiment inventory freeze

data_contract.name: final_filtered700k_graph_eligible_v2_strict40_20260722
data_contract.split_rule: package/source-clone components do not cross train, validation, or test

primary_system.name: same-seed topology-sequence paired system
primary_system.per_seed_system: one Practical HGT checkpoint and one ModernBERT checkpoint with the identical seed

graph_branch.graph_representation: label-blind bounded semantic-budget V10c graph, maximum 16 selected Python files
graph_branch.training: inverse-sqrt source-clone-component weighting, validation-AP checkpoint selection

sequence_branch.model: off-the-shelf answerdotai/ModernBERT-base fine-tuned for package behavior-sequence classification
sequence_branch.input_contract: EA4MP-aligned canonical behavior text, head 512 tokens in the frozen S1 protocol
sequence_branch.originality_boundary: ModernBERT and its Transformer architecture are not claimed as original

fusion.crossfit: five source-clone-component-isolated outer folds; scaler, fusion, and F1 threshold fit on outer-train only
fusion.deployment_fit: fit each same-seed pair on all 2137 validation rows and freeze its scaler, coefficients, intercept, and validation-selected threshold before test
fusion.claim_boundary: a low-variance complementarity integration, not a new fusion algorithm

reporting.primary: three same-seed paired systems reported as arithmetic mean plus or minus sample standard deviation
reporting.three_hgt_plus_one_modernbert: supplementary higher-cost upper-bound reference only, not the primary system

frozen_validation_evidence.interpretation: development validation evidence, not final test performance

accepted_claims: The bounded event-centered heterogeneous behavior graph is the principal task-specific technical contribution.
Correct graph endpoint topology has same-checkpoint faithfulness support from the degree-rewiring intervention.
Topology and canonical behavior-sequence views are complementary under source-clone-isolated cross-fitting.
The V2 source-clone-aware split and leakage-safe operating-point protocol are methodological contributions.
forbidden_claims: ModernBERT or HGT was invented in this work.
The regularized late-fusion algorithm itself is novel.
Exact cross-file edges or a dedicated cross-file encoder have a proven stable global benefit.
The 94.60 percent validation F1 is a final test result.
All historical leakage or all possible clone relations have been eliminated.
EA4MP or Cerebro was reproduced beyond the explicitly documented public-code-aligned boundary.

closed_search_space.allowed_future_changes: only pre-registered ablations, baselines, efficiency, robustness, OOD feasibility, statistics, figures, and writing

remaining_experiments.name: semantic file-budget sensitivity
remaining_experiments.estimated_wall_time: 1-3 hours graph preparation plus 2-4 GPU hours

remaining_experiments.name: exact-V2 baseline and operating-point table
remaining_experiments.fairness: each learning method uses the same validation-derived threshold-selection procedure, not the same numeric threshold; rule tools retain frozen native rules
remaining_experiments.estimated_wall_time: 2-8 hours depending on rule-tool delta evaluation

remaining_experiments.name: static robustness stress tests
remaining_experiments.mode: inference-only paired comparison with unchanged labels and frozen checkpoints/thresholds

remaining_experiments.name: temporal or source-shift generalization evidence

remaining_experiments.estimated_wall_time: 0.5-1 hour feasibility; 3-8 hours if retraining is required

remaining_experiments.name: one-time proposed-model test evaluation
remaining_experiments.mode: three same-seed pairs, frozen validation-derived deployment fits, no fitting or threshold selection on test
remaining_experiments.estimated_wall_time: 1-3 hours after every MUST gate passes

test_unlock_gates: All six primary checkpoints and their code/data contracts match this SHA-bound freeze.
Three deployment fusion fits and thresholds are frozen from validation only.
S9-B through S9-F and S9-H are complete with immutable artifacts; S9-G is complete or explicitly waived for a documented feasibility failure.
The exact rows and statistics of the final paper table are frozen before proposed-model test predictions exist.
The final runner contains no fit, calibration, threshold search, architecture selection, or seed selection on test.
No further architecture or fusion search is permitted after proposed-model test access.
Test authorization requires a separate manifest and explicit user confirmation; S9-A never unlocks it automatically.
